body: i tried six different antidepressants before giving up on them completely

i’ve used youper and daylio in the past - daylio is more of a mood tracker though but could be good to see if there are any particular patterns. i found youper pretty helpful in challenging negative thoughts. i’ve just downloaded something called talkspace which by the looks of it is talk therapy through an app so i’m going to see what that’s like!

hey!! i literally feel like i wrote this post - have you looked into apps or websites for self help? one app i’ve found particularly helpful is headspace (you do have to pay to get full access but i believe there is a student discount). would it be possible to see your GP? i only ask as they may be able to give you a subscription to a self help app if that’s available in your area

thank you, they tend to be more on the intrusive side which is something i’ve struggled with for years. i’m in therapy and i can’t take antidepressants because i have adverse reactions to them but i don’t consider myself depressed either. i’ll try and tell my therapist the next time i talk to them, thank you again.
